title: Feedback:Game updates/20260512
wikitext:
== Update May 12, 2026 ==
* Skill AI adjustments:
**	{{skill icon|Preservation}} - No longer casts outside of combat area to preserve uptime during combat; prioritizes casting if an ally has low health;  targets ally in range w/lowest health percentage.
**	{{skill icon|Spirit Siphon}} - Only checks the values of a potential target spirit (the closest) when determining usefulness;  won't cast if you have plenty of energy;  won't cast unless there is going to be meaningful energy gain.
**	{{skill icon|Soul Leech}} - Prioritizes targeting casters; prioritizes highest health; skips low health targets.
* Some tuning of item drop rates and difficulty in Tunnels of the Forsaken
* Additional client and server updates in advance of soft launch onto mobile

=== Guild Wars Wiki Notes ===
* {{skill icon|Preservation}} - the spirit actually targets the first wounded ally in reverse party order, including [[minion]]s.
